text: A dead tree, waiting for an excuse. {lead} supplies one. In the roots, undisturbed for years: Oak Acorn.
A cheese wheel stuck in a hollow, as they do. {lead} gives it a shove and down the slope it goes, and the hollow gives up Double Gloucester.
A knot of sheep, all facing the wrong way. {lead} works them in a neat curve until the gate is clear. Left on the post for you: a purse, a bit damp.
The old trunk is hollow and ready to go. {lead} heaves, it topples, and out of the hollow rolls Field Mushrooms.
{lead} tips the wheel over the lip and it bounds off downhill with great purpose. Where it was sitting: Cream Tea.
